$comment: The 27 illustrations for Book 1, all on FLUX 1.1 Pro at seed 42 with the shared style block from style.txt. Subject lines are the plan's own, except a10, whose roller is described by its parts because the plan's wording returned a generic machine. Activities 27 and 35 reuse earlier art, and level 5's cut-and-glue pieces are drawn by scripts/pieces.py, so neither appears here.

images.subject: a small cute excavator, side view, with one smooth plain oval track, a boxy cab and a simple two-part arm, sitting on one plain flat ground line.
a neat stack of five long wooden planks, side view, with only a few simple wood grain lines.
two traffic cones with a plain striped tape ribbon stretched between them, the tape has no writing.
a small wall made of three rows of large chunky bricks, front view.
a simple wooden construction fence with a blank rectangular sign board in the middle.
a cute dump truck carrying a load of sand, side view, on the left, and a round pile of sand on the right, with a simple flat ground line.
a cement mixer truck with a big round drum that has simple diagonal stripes, side view.
a bulldozer, side view, with one big flat blade at the front pushing one smooth rounded mound of earth, on one plain flat ground line.
a tall construction crane, side view, with one thick solid upright tower, one long straight arm across the top, and a bundle of three plain pipes hanging from a hook on one straight line.
a steamroller with one huge smooth roller drum at the front instead of front wheels, a small cab on top, and one big back wheel, side view. Its side panel is one smooth plain empty shape.
a tow truck with a hook, towing a small rounded car, side view.
a forklift lifting a stack of three square boxes, side view.
a small skid steer loader with a front bucket, next to three big round rocks, side view.
a dump truck driving over two gentle rolling hills, side view.
an excavator digging, its arm reaching down into a simple hole in the ground, side view.
a half-built building made of big stacked blocks with a ladder leaning against it, front view.
a water tank truck spraying water from the back, the water drawn as a few simple curved lines, side view.
three traffic cones standing in a row with space between them, front view.
a bulldozer at the top of a round hill with a small blank flag on a pole, side view.
a tall construction crane, side view, with one thick solid upright tower, one long straight arm across the top, and one big hook hanging from the end of the arm on one straight line.
a single wooden shipping crate, front view, square shape.
a single cinder block with two square holes, front view.
a single traffic cone with two stripes, front view.
a single large plain wheel, front view: one big smooth circle with one smaller smooth circle in the middle, drawn as two clean unbroken outlines with a plain empty band between them.
a single construction hard hat, side view, with nobody wearing it.
a single diamond-shaped road sign on a short post, with a simple picture of a small digger on the sign and no words.
a single chunky toolbox with a handle on top, front view.
